canonical_project: GDS / DayOne Nongsa Digital Park campus initial project
owner: GDS Holdings / DayOne and Indonesia Investment Authority
notes: GDS announced its Nongsa Digital Park acquisition in November 2021 with plans for two data center buildings totaling about 10,000 sqm net floor area and 28 MW IT power; later reporting links the project to INA and the broader DayOne Batam campus.
